notes.title: v1.0.2 patch notes
notes.notes:
This is a teeny-tiny patch :-)
Thank you all for your feedback!

- enabled VSync
- corrected reported typos
- fixed an unwinnable behavior in Level 7
- fixed issues with "Art camp" achievement 
- fixed issue with a wrong date on the calendar after Level 5
- replaces word "colored" with "colorful"

Cheers,
5am Games team

notes.title: DEMO RELEASE
notes.notes:
DEMO RELEASE

Hey everyone!

We just released a FREE DEMO for Letters!
You can download it right here on Steam on the right-hand side of the page.
Try it and let us know what you think!

We’re also now live on Kickstarter so if you like the game and want to support us, check out our page here:
Kickstarter link

Feel free to share the link with your friends. That would help us out a lot!

We hope you enjoy the demo!
